`intimacy-vocabulary.ts`:
- Export `EXPERIENCE_WORDS`, `ENJOYMENT_WORDS`, `LEAN_WORDS`, `PLACEMENT_WORDS` as readonly tuples copied from the SPEC Scales table.
- Export `Record<Id, string>` label maps for the five lists, typed with the schema id unions so a missing id is a compile error, using the SPEC display column verbatim.
- Export `TEXT_FIELD_LABELS` from the SPEC Text fields table: Stamina & duration, Refractory / recovery time, Volume & amount, Taste & swallowing, Marking & cleanup, Favorite acts & positions, Actively dislikes or avoids, Ideal scene pacing, Additional notes.
- Labels live in the UI half because they are presentation; the schema half stores ids only.

`RatingCard` (selector `cd-rating-card`, OnPush):
- Inputs: `name = input.required<string>()`, `rating = input.required<Rating | CapacityRating>()`, `capacity = input(false)`, `idPrefix = input.required<string>()`, `mode = input<'edit' | 'view'>('edit')`.
- Output: `ratingChange = output<Rating | CapacityRating>()`. Always emit `{ ...rating(), <field>: value }`.
- Template, following the prototype buildRatingList: `.rating-card` with `[class.unset]` when mode is view and both levels are 0; `.rating-name`; two `cd-meter` elements with label 'Experience' / 'Enjoyment', the vocabulary words, `groupLabel` 'Experience: ' + name() / 'Enjoyment: ' + name(), and mode passed through.
- Capacity row when `capacity()`:
  - Edit mode: `.capacity-fields` holding two `.capacity-field` blocks, each `<label [for]="idPrefix() + '-max-length'">Max length</label>` with `<input type="text" [id] [attr.maxlength]="SHORT_TEXT_MAX" placeholder="e.g. 8 in" [value]>`, and the same for Max girth with `-max-girth` and "e.g. 5 in". Input handlers strip `/[^\P{Cc}\n\t]/gu` before emitting.
  - View mode: render the row only when at least one string is non-empty, and each field only when non-empty, as a `span.capacity-label` plus a `span.capacity-value`.
- SCSS: port the prototype `.rating-card`, `.rating-name`, `.capacity-fields`, `.capacity-field` rules with tokens: `--surface-2`, 1px `--border`, 3px `--accent` left border, `--radius-lg`, padding 13px 15px 14px, column gap 8px. Capacity inputs use `--surface` and `--radius-sm`. Add `.unset { opacity: 0.7; }` and `break-inside: avoid`. No elevation or hover motion effects (SPEC-design-system §2). Stay under 4 kB.
  </action>
